question: Name the first Odissi classical dancer from Odisha who was conferred the Padma Vibhushan Award.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Kelucharan Mohapatra was a well-known guru, performer, and exponent of Indian classical dance.
 
• In the 20th century, he is credited with bringing back and popularizing this classical dancing style.
 
• He is the first recipient of Odisha's Padma Vibhushan.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dcb18551962722dc21ff1f031d2c57f6bee45e85d4eca68214292512306df29.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bijayini Satpathy :**

 
 
• For twenty years, Bijayini served as a **principal dancer **and **soloist** with the **Nrityagram Dance Ensemble.**
 
 
 
• **Sonal Mansingh:**
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance styles** are taught by Indian classical dancer **Sonal Mansingh.**
 
• She received the **Padma Bhushan in 1992** and the **Padma Vibhushan in 2003** as the youngest recipient.
 
 
 
• **Gngadhar Pradhan:**
 
 
• **Indian Odissi dancer **Gangadhar Pradhan was well-known.
 
• In **1998,** he received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Prize**, and in **2008,** he received the** Padma Shri.**
 
 

4d:T
